description: This file contains the implementation of the ProfileReader class within the Profiles feature of the project. It includes methods to read and assemble user profile data, involving database queries, user context retrieval, and object mapping.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: Implements profile reading functionality, fetching user profile data and following status from the database, utilizing dependency-injected context, user accessor, and mapper.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a user profile by username, including current user follow status, and returns a wrapped profile envelope.
